groups.rationale: Real external method calls in pretty_imshow: axis is plt.gca() (an Axes), so axis.imshow is Axes.imshow, and data includes the make_mosaic result (numpy.ma.masked_all), whose .min()/.max() are MaskedArray methods. identity:factory-return. Archway names each callee after the factory that produced the receiver (matplotlib.pyplot.gca.imshow, numpy.ma.masked_all.min/max), not after its class, so exclude these if factory-return identities are being withdrawn.
